attemptsRemaining: {failed} failed check(s) — {remaining} remaining before a new challenge is needed.
challengeExpiry: Challenge expires 7 days after it was issued.
confirmDelete: Delete {domain}? Its verification history is removed too. Forms linked to it must be unlinked first.
confirmSuspend: Suspend {domain}? It will stop accepting submissions.
deleteDescription: Deleting removes the domain and its verification history. A domain linked to forms cannot be deleted until it is unlinked.
description: Register and verify the domains your forms accept submissions from
dnsBody: Add a TXT record to {domain} at your DNS provider. It usually propagates within a few minutes.
domainHint: A scheme, path or www prefix is stripped automatically — https://www.example.com/blog becomes example.com.
downloadHint: Download the file and upload it as-is — no editing needed.
emailVerificationDescription: Verify your email before registering a domain. Until then your account works, but domain registration stays locked.
emptyDescription: Register a domain and verify ownership to start receiving form submissions from your sites.
fileBody: Upload a file named sendcms-verification.txt to your site's public folder — the same place ads.txt goes — so it is reachable at the URL below. Its entire content must be the code shown.
metaBody: Add this tag inside the <head> of https://{domain}/.
methodHint: DNS TXT works for any host. The meta tag and file methods need your site to be reachable over HTTPS.
newDescription: Register a domain, then prove you own it
suspendedDescription: This domain is not accepting submissions. Reactivate it to resume — it keeps its verified status.
switchFailed: Could not switch the verification method.
switchHint: Switches to the selected method — the verification value stays the same.
title: Domains
verifiedDescription: This domain can receive form submissions. Only verified domains are accepted by the submission API.
verifiedMessage: Verified — this domain can now receive submissions.
